meaning:
ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον
(διαλείπω),
unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) †

elsewhere.note: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
